input.quote: (k) REPRESENTATION BY COUNSEL. Each party acknowledges that it has had the opportunity to be represented by separate independent counsel in the negotiation of this Agreement
input.rationale: The Agreement contains no insurance covenant anywhere: the only reference to "insurance" is a pass-through of taxes, customs, duties, insurance and shipping charges payable by Licensee (p0051), and Article XXIV General Provisions (p0144–p0160) runs from governing law to representation by counsel with no coverage obligation. Licensor hosts the Platform and processes our trade data, so the absence of any coverage sits in walk-away territory. We insert the shortest covenant meeting the fallback position (E&O USD 1,000,000 and cyber/privacy USD 2,000,000) rather than the preferred CGL/E&O USD 2M/cyber USD 5M package, and would accept the preferred limits if Licensor prefers a broader programme.

mappings.element: Professional errors and omissions coverage is at least USD 1,000,000.
Cyber and privacy coverage is at least USD 2,000,000.

ops.text: (l) INSURANCE. Licensor shall maintain professional liability (errors and omissions) insurance of not less than USD 1,000,000 and cyber and privacy liability insurance of not less than USD 2,000,000.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] The Agreement carries no insurance covenant even though Licensor hosts the platform and processes our trade data, so we added our fallback minimums: errors and omissions of USD 1,000,000 and cyber and privacy of USD 2,000,000.
proposal.summary: Insert a short insurance covenant (E&O USD 1M; cyber and privacy USD 2M) in General Provisions.
